---
title: "ZOIB Modeling for Specific CpGs in PSD95 Dataset (Bayesian Approach)"
---

```{r}
# ==============================================================
# Switch to brms for Zero-One-Inflated Beta (ZOIB) Models
# ==============================================================
# brms has built-in zero_one_inflated_beta() family – perfect for methylation proportions
# with excess exact 0 and/or 1 (no need for manual epsilon adjustment).
# It models:
# - zoi: probability of zero or one inflation
# - coi: conditional on inflation, probability of one vs zero
# - mu/phi: conditional beta mean/precision on (0,1)
#
# Advantages: Handles extremes properly, Bayesian regularization (helps convergence),
# full posterior for contrasts.
# Downsides: Slower than glmmTMB (minutes for filtered, hours for full on typical machine).
#
# Install if needed (once): install.packages("brms")
library(brms)
library(emmeans)     # For marginal means/contrasts (works with brms)
library(bayesplot)   # For pp_check etc.
library(tidybayes)   # Optional for tidy posteriors
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================
# Load Data (as in your code - assuming already run)
 psd95 <- suppressWarnings(read_xlsx("~/Work/TBM-R-Analysis/tables/Rohdaten/PSD95_CpGs_mit_verhalten_größer_umstrukturiert.xlsx"))
# ==============================================================
```


```{r}
# ==============================================================
# 1. Filter to Specific CpGs of Interest
# ==============================================================
# Assuming "filter for" means keep only these CpGs (e.g., for focused analysis)
# If you meant exclude them, change to !CpG_Position %in% ...
psd95_specific <- psd95 %>%
  filter(CpG_Position %in% c("p95", "p60", "p23"))
```


```{r}
# ==============================================================
# 2. Preprocessing: Identify and Exclude Invariant/Low-Variability CpGs (among the specific ones)
# ==============================================================

# Compute summary stats per CpG across ALL samples
cpg_summary <- psd95_specific %>%
  group_by(CpG_Position) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_meth = mean(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_meth = sd(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_meth = min(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_meth = max(methylation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    range_meth = max_meth - min_meth,
    is_invariant = (sd_meth == 0 | range_meth < 0.05)  # Threshold: SD=0 or range<5%
  )

# Print to inspect
print(cpg_summary)

# Filter data to exclude invariant CpGs (if any among the 3)
psd95_filtered <- psd95_specific %>%
  inner_join(cpg_summary %>% filter(!is_invariant) %>% select(CpG_Position), by = "CpG_Position")
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================
# Prepare Raw Proportion (Ensure Strictly (0,1) for Beta Family)
# ==============================================================
# Beta family requires 0 < y < 1. If any exact 0 or 1, add small epsilon or use zero_one_inflated_beta
psd95_beta <- psd95_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    meth_prop = methylation,  # Assume already 0-1 proportion
    # Adjust extremes if needed (common safe practice)
    meth_prop_adj = case_when(
      meth_prop == 0 ~ 0.0001,
      meth_prop == 1 ~ 0.9999,
      TRUE ~ meth_prop
    )
  )

# Check for exact 0/1
table(psd95_beta$meth_prop == 0 | psd95_beta$meth_prop == 1)
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================
# 1. ZOIB Model on Filtered Data (3 Specific CpGs: p23, p60, p95)
# ==============================================================
# Use raw methylation (0-1 exact values OK – ZOIB handles them)
fit_zoi_filtered <- brm(
  methylation ~ Gruppe * Zeitpunkt + Age_start + Sex + 
                (1 | ID:CpG_Position),               # Nested random intercept
  data = psd95_filtered,                              # Your filtered dataset
  family = zero_one_inflated_beta(),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 2), class = "b"),                 # Fixed effects
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
    prior(exponential(2), class = "sd"),              # Random SDs
    prior(beta(1,1), class = "zoi"),                  # Uniform on inflation prob
    prior(beta(1,1), class = "coi")                   # Uniform on conditional one|inflation
  ),
  chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000,              # More iters for stability
  cores = 4,                                          # Parallel
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 12),
  seed = 123
)

# Save if needed: saveRDS(fit_zoi_filtered, "psd95_zoi_filtered.rds")

# Diagnostics
summary(fit_zoi_filtered)
bayes_R2(fit_zoi_filtered)          # Bayesian R2 (marginal/conditional analogs)
pp_check(fit_zoi_filtered, ndraws = 50) + xlim(0,1)  # Posterior predictive (proportions)
plot(fit_zoi_filtered)              # Trace plots

# Marginal effects / contrasts on proportion scale
conditional_effects(fit_zoi_filtered, effects = "Zeitpunkt:Gruppe", response = TRUE)

emmeans(fit_zoi_filtered, ~ Gruppe | Zeitpunkt, type = "response") |> pairs()
emmeans(fit_zoi_filtered, ~ Zeitpunkt | Gruppe, type = "response") |> pairs(adjust = "tukey")
```

```{r}
library(report)
report(fit_zoi_filtered)
```
